_comment: Ensemble scenario configuration for the EA-EM pipeline (run_pipeline.py).
Each top-level key (except '_comment' and '_schema') is a named scenario.
Pass the scenario name via:  python run_pipeline.py --scenario <name>
SCENARIOS IN THIS FILE
2d       Synthetic 2-D UTM grid run (data_source omitted -> synthetic).
2d_dense_tdr  Same as '2d' but 10 SWC positions (40 probes) for denser TDR coverage.
1d_surface_tdr  1-D transect (--mode 1d), truth m/sigma_s vary along x; TDR ONLY at 0.2 m so only horizon 0 is calibrated.
1d_full_depth_ref  Same as 1d_surface_tdr but probes in all 4 horizons (reference for the comparison).
1d_{surface,full}_free{K}  (K=1..4) Surface-only vs full-depth TDR with K free WS params (order sigma_s, m, sigma_w, a); used by run_1d_surface_vs_full.sh.
2d_random_xy_drying  Same '2d' family, but a RANDOM (patchy) plan-view
moisture pattern instead of a linear ramp, blended with a
spatially-uniform depth trend that dries out with depth.
See full_range_gradient / random_xy_* fields below.
2d_real  Same 2-D UTM survey geometry and inversion settings, but
driven by real GEM-2 EM data + SoilNet TDR data.
FIELD REFERENCE
output_dir        str   Output folder for plots, cache, and NPY files.
realization_index int   Which synthetic ground-truth member to use (0-based).
Ignored when using real field data.
depths0           list  Starting layer interface depths [m], length = n_layers-1.
fixed_depths      bool  True  → all interfaces pinned (classic mode).
or  list  False → all interfaces free to move during inversion.
[bool…] → per-interface control, same length as depths0.
param_grid        obj   Cartesian-product inversion parameter sweep.
Recognised keys (all optional, all accept a list):
alpha        regularisation weight  (float > 0)
method       scipy optimiser string
forwardModel EMagPy forward model key
Valid method values:  L-BFGS-B | CG | Nelder-Mead | SLSQP | TNC
Valid forwardModel values: CS | FSlin | FS | QP
alpha_range_log   list  Overrides param_grid['alpha'] with a log-spaced sweep.
or  null  Format: [min, max, n_steps]  (min and max both > 0,
min < max, n_steps >= 2). null → param_grid['alpha'] used as-is.
cond_ranges       list  Per-layer starting conductivity bounds [mS/m].
Each element is [min, max] or [single_value].
Length must equal number of layers (len(depths0)+1).
forward_model     str   Default EMagPy forward model for all ensemble members.
Per-member overrides go in param_grid['forwardModel'].
gamma             float Temporal regularisation between time steps (>= 0).
0.0 → no smoothing (recommended for most cases).
ws_fixed_params  obj   Waxman-Smits params held fixed at lab_p0 during
Steps 2/4 calibration, e.g. {"m": true}.
Keys: a | m | sigma_w | sigma_s (bool values).
Omit/null -> all four params float freely.
lab_p0            list  Starting-guess / pinned WS params [a, m, sigma_w,
sigma_s], flat (applied to every horizon) or one
4-element list per horizon (len == len(depths0)+1).
Omit/null -> DEFAULT_WS_P0 = [1.5, 1.8, 50.0, 5.0].
ws_localized_bandwidth  float  Gaspari-Cohn localization radius 'c' (same
units as transect x-coords, e.g. metres). When set,
runs step2.run_petro_localized as a DIAGNOSTIC
sibling to Step 2 (does NOT feed Steps 3-5); saves
petro_calibration_localized.png (sigma_s(x) per
horizon). Kernel support is zero beyond 2*c, so c
should be at least ~half the adjacent-probe spacing.
Omit/null -> localized diagnostic disabled (default).
ws_localized_bandwidth_sweep  list  Candidate bandwidths (c values) to
test via leave-one-probe-out CV before running the
localized diagnostic; the recommended bandwidth
overrides ws_localized_bandwidth. Evaluated once
against the rank-1 ensemble member.
Omit/null -> sweep disabled, fixed
ws_localized_bandwidth (if any) used as-is.
data_source       str   'real' | 'synthetic' (omit for synthetic).
em_data_dir       str   Folder with GEM-2 real EM CSVs (real data_source only).
tdr_data_dir      str   Folder with real TDR XLSX files (real data_source only).
coord_file        str   CSV of sensor/position coordinates (real data_source only).
time_tolerance_days float Max days between EM survey and TDR reading to match (real only).
SWC / TDR SENSOR NETWORK FIELDS
num_swc_positions int   Number of horizontal positions where SWC/TDR sensors
are placed. Total probes = num_swc_positions × n_layers.
swc_depths        list  Explicit sensor installation depths [m].
or  null  null → pipeline derives depths from layer_centers
(midpoints of depths0 intervals).
window_m          float Half-width of the spatial averaging window that matches
each TDR probe to its nearest EM measurement indices [m].
If [WARN] 'No EM measurement within window_m' appears, increase this value.
matching_warn_fraction  float  TDR<->EM spatial-matching quality gate (warn level).
If the single most-shared EM point ends up matched to more
than this fraction of ALL probes, the run report logs a
[WARN]. Range (0, 1]. Default 0.5.
matching_error_fraction float  Same as above but aborts the run before Step 2 if
or  null  exceeded. null (default) disables this hard gate.
OBSERVATION NOISE FIELDS (synthetic scenarios only)
eca_noise_level   float Relative Gaussian noise added to synthetic ECa BEFORE
inversion (std = eca_noise_level × ECa_signal).
tdr_noise_std     float Absolute Gaussian noise added to theta_obs [m³/m³].
homogeneous       bool  True  → disables both spatial gradients (XY position
and XZ/depth) in synthetic generation, so theta is
spatially uniform. Temporal trend (progressive
wetting over timesteps) and per-sample noise are
still applied. Ignored for data_source='real'.
Default: false.
full_range_gradient bool  True → static XZ (depth) and XY (plan-view)
initial-model gradients each span the FULL
[theta_dry, theta_wet] range independently,
instead of the small default-gradient offset.
Combined via xy_z_blend. Ignored when
homogeneous=true. Default: false.
xy_z_blend        float Only used when full_range_gradient=true. Weight
in [0, 1] between the XY component (1.0 = XY
only) and the Z/depth component (0.0 = Z only).
Default: 0.5 (equal blend).
invert_z_gradient bool  Only used when full_range_gradient=true. True →
flips the depth gradient so the shallowest layer
is wet and the deepest is dry, i.e. the soil
dries out uniformly with depth (same rate at
every XY location). Default: false (dry at
surface, wet at depth).
random_xy_field   bool  Only used when full_range_gradient=true. True →
replaces the linear XY ramp with a smooth,
spatially-correlated RANDOM field (scattered
wet/dry patches) instead of one monotonic
direction. One field per ensemble member, fixed
across all timesteps/layers within that member.
Default: false.
random_xy_n_blobs int   Only used when random_xy_field=true. Number of
random Gaussian patches summed into the field.
More → busier/fragmented; fewer → broad zones.
Default: 8.
random_xy_correlation_m float or null  Only used when random_xy_field=
true. Patch radius [m] (1-sigma). null (default)
auto-picks ~1/4 of the survey's shorter extent.
random_xy_seed    int or null  Only used when random_xy_field=true.
Seeds the random field independently of the
per-sample noise stream, for reproducibility.
null (default) derives a seed from 42.
ws_xy_variation   bool  True → the TRUTH Waxman-Smits params (a, m,
sigma_w, sigma_s) vary spatially in XY instead of
being spatially uniform, independent of the
theta gradient above. This is the ground-truth
petrophysics, not the Step-2 calibration fit.
Default: false.
ws_xy_params      list  Only used when ws_xy_variation=true. Subset of
["a","m","sigma_w","sigma_s"] that varies in XY;
every other param stays fixed at its lab default.
Default: ["m", "sigma_s"].
ws_xy_ranges      obj   Only used when ws_xy_variation=true. Per-param
{"param": [min, max]} truth range spanned across
the XY field. Default per param: a [0.3,0.7],
ws_xy_pattern     str   Only used when ws_xy_variation=true. "linear"
(diagonal x/y ramp, same convention as theta) or
"random" (smooth spatially-correlated random
field, independently seeded from the moisture
pattern). Default: "linear".
ws_xy_n_blobs     int   Only used when ws_xy_pattern=random. Number of
random Gaussian patches. Default: 6.
ws_xy_correlation_m float or null  Only used when ws_xy_pattern=random.
Patch radius [m]. null (default) auto-picks.
ws_xy_seed        int or null  Only used when ws_xy_pattern=random.
Seeds the WS-parameter field independently of
random_xy_seed. null (default) derives from 99.
cache_tag         str   Optional suffix appended to the cache filename.
Change this whenever you alter depths0 or cond_ranges
to avoid loading a stale cached ensemble.
description       str   Free-text label shown in pipeline log and report.
HOW TO RUN SCENARIOS
Synthetic 2-D UTM grid run:
./run_pipeline.sh --mode 2d -s 2d
Real-data 2-D UTM grid run:
./run_pipeline.sh --mode 2d -s 2d_real
── Spatial grid size (2-D mode only) ────────────────────────
Control the number of UTM grid points with --nx and --ny.
./run_pipeline.sh --mode 2d -s 2d --nx 15 --ny 8
./run_pipeline.sh --mode 2d -s 2d_real --nx 15 --ny 8
── Calling run_pipeline.py directly (without the shell wrapper) ─────
python run_pipeline.py --scenario 2d --mode 2d
python run_pipeline.py --scenario 2d_real --mode 2d
── Scenario discovery & validation ───────────────────────────────
List all available scenarios:
./run_pipeline.sh --list
python scenario_loader.py --list
Validate every scenario in the JSON (catches schema errors before running):
./run_pipeline.sh --validate
python -c "from scenario_loader import validate_all; validate_all()"
Inspect a single scenario's resolved config:
python scenario_loader.py 2d
python scenario_loader.py 2d_real
── Full argument reference (run_pipeline.sh) ────────────────────
-s / --scenario NAME    Scenario key from this JSON file (2d | 2d_real)
-c / --config   PATH    Path to a custom JSON scenario file
--mode     1d|2d   Spatial mode (default: 1d; use 2d for these scenarios)
--nx       INT     Grid columns in 2-D mode (default: 10)
--ny       INT     Grid rows    in 2-D mode (default: 5)
--list             Print scenario names and exit
--validate         Validate all scenarios and exit
-h / --help             Show shell usage message

2d.description: 2-D UTM grid run with realistic observation noise, 2 TDR positions per layer, all interfaces free, and a narrow ECa conductivity range (1-60 mS/m) representative of resistive field soils.

2d_horizon_ws.description: Same '2d' family (2-D UTM grid, realistic noise, 2 TDR positions/layer, 1-60 mS/m conductivity range), but with per-horizon Waxman-Smits parameters instead of a single flat lab_p0. Encodes a plausible depth trend: cementation exponent m increases with depth (compaction/reduced porosity) while surface conductivity sigma_s decreases with depth (organic matter/clay content falls off below the topsoil). a and sigma_w held roughly constant across horizons. a and m are pinned (ws_fixed_params), so the per-horizon values directly control calibration; sigma_w/sigma_s are just per-horizon starting guesses since they float freely.

2d_intermediate.description: 2-D UTM grid run with realistic observation noise, 2 TDR positions per layer, all interfaces free, and a narrow ECa conductivity range (1-60 mS/m) representative of resistive field soils.

2d_dense_tdr.description: Dense-TDR counterpart of the '2d' scenario: identical grid geometry, layer depths, WS priors and conductivity range, but with num_swc_positions raised from 2 -> 10 (40 total probes on the default 10x5 grid) for stronger per-horizon petrophysical calibration.

2d_random_xy_drying.description: 2-D UTM grid run with a MORE RANDOM (patchy, non-linear) plan-view soil-moisture pattern instead of the simple diagonal ramp used by '2d': theta_xy is a smooth spatially-correlated random field (sum of random Gaussian wet/dry patches, see random_xy_* below), blended with a spatially-UNIFORM depth trend that dries out with depth (invert_z_gradient=true -> wet at the surface, progressively drier at depth, same rate everywhere in plan view). Same grid/inversion settings family as '2d', with a denser SWC network (8 positions) since a heterogeneous XY field needs more spatial sampling to calibrate well than a monotonic gradient does.

2d_xy_waxman.description: Same '2d' family (2-D UTM grid, realistic noise, 1-60 mS/m conductivity range), but the ground-truth Waxman-Smits parameters themselves vary spatially in XY (ws_xy_variation), rather than theta as in '2d_random_xy_drying'. Cementation exponent m and surface conductivity sigma_s are drawn from a smooth, spatially-correlated random field (ws_xy_pattern='random'), independently seeded from the moisture pattern; a and sigma_w stay fixed at lab defaults everywhere. theta itself follows the same simple diagonal ramp as '2d' (random_xy_field is NOT set here), so the XY heterogeneity under test is purely petrophysical, not a moisture artifact. m and sigma_s float during calibration (ws_fixed_params) since they're the params that actually vary in the truth; a and sigma_w are pinned. Denser SWC network (4 positions) than the base '2d', since a spatially heterogeneous petrophysics field needs more spatial sampling to calibrate than a uniform lab_p0 does.

1d_surface_tdr.description: 1-D transect test of surface-only TDR (run with --mode 1d): 10 survey points along x (2 m spacing, y=0), truth m and sigma_s vary smoothly along x (same field at every depth), ECa noise 1%, TDR noise 0.01. TDR probes ONLY at 0.2 m (horizon 0 of depths0=[0.3,0.6,1.0]); horizons 1-3 are deliberately uncalibrated (prior lab_p0). Sweep the probe count with --num-swc-positions N (probes are spread along x). Reference: '1d_full_depth_ref' (identical except probes in all 4 horizons).

1d_full_depth_ref.description: Reference for '1d_surface_tdr' (run with --mode 1d): identical truth, noise and inversion settings, but one probe per layer centre at every probe position (all 4 horizons calibrated). Use the same --num-swc-positions N as the surface-only run.

1d_surface_hetero_free4_pin0.description: ORACLE headroom test for conditioning: same as '1d_surface_hetero_free4' (TDR only at 0.2 m) but the Step 1 inversion pins layer 0 to its TRUE bulk EC (pin_layers, pin_source=truth), so layers 1-3 are inverted conditioned on a perfectly known surface layer. Upper bound of what a TDR-derived layer-0 pin could give; compare vs '1d_surface_hetero_free4' (free) and '1d_full_hetero_free4' (full-depth TDR).

1d_surface_free4_pin0.description: ORACLE headroom test for conditioning on the uniform-in-depth truth: '1d_surface_free4' with layer 0 pinned to its TRUE bulk EC in the Step 1 inversion (see '1d_surface_hetero_free4_pin0').
